scoring.items: Final cart after the last turn must equal expect.items exactly: same catalog row (exact productos_tienda name), same qty (±0.01), same unit (pz|kg|$), same variant for Refresco. Extra, invented, merged or missing lines fail. For ask=clarify, pending/unresolved lines are ignored; only confirmed lines are compared.
scoring.ask: none: reply must not ask about products (no '¿Cuál', '¿Te refieres', '¿chica o grande', '¿Una más'); the 'OK, pediste… ¿Están bien?' list is allowed. clarify: reply must ask, and contain every word in ask_contains (accent/case-insensitive). not_available: reply must say it is not handled (no lo manejamos / no tenemos / no hay) and mention the not_available term.
scoring.units: La Central: meats default kg; pieces (pz) for Carbón fino and salsas; $ = amount in pesos (convert to kg only at pricing). George: pz.
